$comment: When each drop OPENS (24-hour HH:MM, in the timezone below): 2 drops per category, at 04:00 and 16:00. Used by the API (a drop is only served after its time) and the app. Drops are written ahead by the generator (cron at 04:00 and 16:00 IST). "articles" is when each day's articles are written and shown.
